stories.title: Fahiş fiyat operasyonunda sebze-meyve dağıtıcısı 41 firmanın yöneticisine gözaltı kararı: Tarımda sistem adaletsiz

en.title: Detention decisions issued for 41 produce distributor managers in excessive price operation: Agricultural system deemed unjust
en.summary: Authorities ordered detention for executives of 41 major produce distributors accused of manipulating fresh vegetable and fruit prices for unlawful profit. Agricultural experts argued the underlying issue extends beyond market manipulation to systemic vulnerabilities affecting both farmers and consumers.

en.title: YENİ Party sends guidelines to 81 provinces for new organizational model: Political ethics to begin within party
en.summary: A political party distributed organizational guidelines to all provinces and established ethical codes for its leadership. The party plans to implement political ethics standards internally first, preventing power concentration, economic gain from positions, and nepotism among its members.

en.title: Drone alleged to belong to Houthis approaching Mecca shot down
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's air defense destroyed a Houthi drone that approached Mecca's restricted airspace south of the city. The incident marks an escalation of regional tensions as Riyadh treats the security of holy sites and pilgrims as a red line.

stories.title: Türkiye için yüzde 100 tarife riski bugün oylanıyor

en.title: 100 percent tariff risk for Turkey to be voted on today
en.summary: A new U.S. sanctions package targeting Russia and Iran reaches a critical voting stage today. The proposal would authorize tariffs of up to 100 percent on major buyers of Russian energy, with Turkey's substantial imports of Russian energy at particular risk.
